examples.ko: 그녀의 책상은 항상 깔끔하게 정돈돼 있어.

examples.en: Keep your room tidy, please.

senses.note: neat and tidy 로 자주 붙여 씀. clean(더럽지 않은)과 tidy(물건이 정리된)는 다름.

senses.meaningEn: to put things in their right place so a room looks neat

examples.en: Let's tidy the living room before Mom comes.
examples.ko: 엄마 오시기 전에 거실 좀 치우자.

examples.en: I need to tidy my desk.

senses.note: tidy up = 정리하다. 미국에서는 clean up 이 더 흔하고 tidy 는 영국식 느낌.

senses.meaningEn: feeling that you need to rest or sleep

examples.en: I'm so tired. I didn't sleep well last night.
examples.ko: 너무 피곤해. 어젯밤에 잠을 잘 못 잤어.

examples.en: You look tired. Why don't you go to bed early?
examples.ko: 피곤해 보여. 일찍 자는 게 어때?

senses.note: be/feel/get/look tired. 매우 피곤하면 exhausted. 피곤하게 만드는 것은 tiring(a tiring day).

senses.meaningEn: bored with something because it has happened too often

examples.en: I'm tired of eating the same thing every day.
examples.ko: 매일 같은 것 먹는 게 지겨워.

examples.en: She is tired of waiting for his call.
examples.ko: 그녀는 그의 전화를 기다리는 데 지쳤어.

senses.note: be tired of + 명사/-ing. sick of 와 비슷하며 sick and tired of 로 강조.

senses.meaningEn: one of the five parts at the end of your foot

examples.en: Ouch, I hit my toe on the door.
Wiggle your toes to warm them up.

senses.note: 손가락은 finger, 발가락은 toe. big toe(엄지발가락), little toe(새끼발가락).

senses.meaningEn: the bowl with a seat that you sit on to use the bathroom

examples.en: The toilet is clogged again.
Please flush the toilet after you use it.
examples.ko: 사용한 뒤에는 변기 물을 내려 주세요.

senses.note: flush the toilet = 변기 물을 내리다. toilet paper = 휴지.

senses.meaningEn: a room with a toilet in it

examples.en: Excuse me, where's the toilet?
I need to go to the toilet.

senses.note: 미국에서는 toilet 이 변기 자체를 뜻해서 '화장실 어디예요?'는 Where's the bathroom/restroom? 이 자연스러움. 영국·호주에서는 toilet 으로 화장실을 말함.

senses.meaningEn: a soft red fruit eaten as a vegetable, often in salads and sauces

examples.en: Add two tomatoes to the salad.
I don't like raw tomato.

senses.note: 복수형은 tomatoes(-es). 미국식 발음은 /təˈmeɪtoʊ/, 영국식은 /təˈmɑːtəʊ/.

senses.meaningEn: the soft part inside your mouth that you taste and speak with

examples.en: I burned my tongue on the hot soup.
Stick out your tongue, please.

senses.note: 발음은 '텅'(/tʌŋ/), 끝의 ue 는 소리 나지 않음. 혀를 깨물다 = bite my tongue.

senses.meaningEn: a language, especially the one you learned as a child

examples.en: Korean is my mother tongue.
English is not her native tongue.

senses.note: mother tongue = native language(모국어). 보통 이 표현 안에서만 쓰고, 일반적인 '언어'는 language.

senses.meaningEn: one of the hard white things in your mouth that you bite with

examples.en: I have a loose tooth.
The dentist pulled out my bad tooth.

senses.note: 한 개는 tooth, 두 개 이상은 teeth(tooths ×). 이가 아프다 = have a toothache. 치과 = the dentist's.

senses.meaningEn: a pain in one of your teeth

examples.en: I have a toothache, so I'm going to the dentist.
A bad toothache kept me awake all night.
examples.ko: 심한 치통 때문에 밤새 잠을 못 잤어.

senses.note: tooth(이 하나) + ache. 치과 = the dentist / dentist's office. 이가 아프다 = My tooth hurts.

senses.meaningEn: a small brush used for cleaning your teeth

examples.en: I need a new toothbrush. This one is old.
Don't forget to pack your toothbrush.

senses.note: tooth(단수)+brush. teethbrush 라고 하지 않는다. 전동 칫솔은 electric toothbrush.

senses.meaningEn: a soft substance you put on a toothbrush to clean your teeth

examples.en: Put a little toothpaste on the brush.
Which toothpaste do you use?

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사. '치약 하나'는 a tube of toothpaste.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of soft cloth used for drying yourself or things

examples.en: Can you hand me a towel, please?
The hotel gives you fresh towels every day.
examples.ko: 그 호텔은 매일 새 수건을 줘.

senses.note: 목욕 수건 bath towel, 손 수건 hand towel, 종이 타월 paper towel. 발음은 [타월]에 가깝다.

senses.meaningEn: things you throw away because you do not want them

examples.en: Can you take out the trash tonight?
examples.ko: 오늘 밤 쓰레기 좀 내다 버려 줄래?

examples.en: Don't leave trash on the table.

senses.note: 미국식. 영국에서는 rubbish. take out the trash = 쓰레기를 내다 버리다. 셀 수 없는 명사라 a trash (X).

senses.meaningEn: a container that you put trash in

examples.en: Throw it in the trash can over there.
The trash can is full again.

senses.note: garbage can 도 같은 뜻. 영국에서는 bin. 컴퓨터 화면의 쓰레기통도 trash.

senses.meaningEn: to change direction

examples.en: Turn left at the next corner.
Turn around, you're going the wrong way.

senses.note: turn left / turn right / turn around. 길 안내의 기본 표현.

senses.meaningEn: to become a different color, state, or age

examples.en: The leaves turn red in October.
My son turns seven next month.
examples.ko: 우리 아들은 다음 달에 일곱 살이 돼.

senses.note: turn + 색/나이. turn thirty = 서른 살이 되다.

senses.meaningEn: the time when it is your chance to do something

examples.en: It's your turn to roll the dice.
Please wait your turn in line.

senses.note: take turns = 번갈아 하다.

senses.meaningEn: to make a machine, light, or water stop

examples.en: Turn off your phone during the movie.
examples.ko: 영화 보는 동안 폰 꺼 줘.

examples.en: Did you turn off the water in the bathroom?

senses.note: turn off 는 전원·물·가스 모두 가능. switch off 도 같은 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: to leave the road you are driving on

examples.en: Turn off at the next exit.
We turned off the highway to get gas.

senses.meaningEn: to make a machine or light start working

examples.en: Can you turn on the TV?
Turn the light on, it's too dark.

senses.note: turn on the TV / turn the TV on 둘 다 가능. 대명사는 turn it on 만 가능.

senses.meaningEn: to make water or gas start flowing

examples.en: Turn on the hot water for the bath.
Don't turn on the gas yet.

senses.meaningEn: short for television; the machine with a screen

examples.en: Turn off the TV and go to bed.
The TV in my room is really small.

senses.note: 보통 대문자 TV 로 씀. the TV = 기기, 복수는 TVs.

senses.meaningEn: the programs you watch on television

examples.en: What's on TV tonight?
I saw him on TV yesterday.

senses.note: watch TV, on TV 에는 the 를 붙이지 않음. TV show = TV 프로그램.

senses.meaningEn: one of two children born to the same mother at the same time

examples.en: My brother and I are twins.
She has a twin sister who looks just like her.
examples.ko: 그녀는 자기랑 똑 닮은 쌍둥이 여동생이 있어.

senses.note: 두 명을 말할 때 twins. identical twins = 일란성 쌍둥이, twin brother/sister = 쌍둥이 형제/자매.

senses.meaningEn: having two matching parts, such as two single beds

examples.en: I'd like a twin room for two nights, please.
examples.ko: 1인용 침대 두 개 있는 방으로 이틀 묵고 싶어요.

examples.en: The hotel room has twin beds.
examples.ko: 그 호텔 방에는 1인용 침대가 두 개 있어.

senses.note: 호텔 예약 필수 단어. twin room(침대 두 개) vs double room(2인용 침대 하나).

senses.meaningEn: the brother of your mother or father, or the husband of your aunt

examples.en: My uncle gave me a bike for my birthday.
Uncle Tom tells the funniest jokes.
examples.ko: 톰 삼촌은 정말 재미있는 농담을 하셔.

senses.note: 삼촌·외삼촌·고모부·이모부 모두 uncle. 한국어처럼 모르는 아저씨를 uncle 이라고 부르지 않음.

senses.meaningEn: to or on a higher floor of a building

examples.en: Go upstairs and brush your teeth.
My bedroom is upstairs, next to the bathroom.
examples.ko: 내 방은 위층에 있어, 욕실 옆에.

senses.note: go upstairs 처럼 to 없이 바로 씀(go to upstairs ✗). 형용사로도 씀: the upstairs bathroom.

senses.meaningEn: a plant or part of a plant that is eaten as food, such as a carrot or onion

examples.en: Eat your vegetables before you have dessert.
We buy fresh vegetables at the market every week.
examples.ko: 우리는 매주 시장에서 신선한 채소를 사.

senses.note: 보통 복수형 vegetables 로 씀. 일상 대화에서는 veggies 로 줄여 말함. 발음은 3음절 [베지터블]이 아니라 [베취터블]처럼 e 를 거의 생략.

senses.meaningEn: to go to see a person or a place

examples.en: We visited my grandma last weekend.
I want to visit Japan next year.

senses.note: visit to Japan (X) → visit Japan. 동사 뒤에 전치사 없이 바로 장소·사람. 웹사이트 방문도 visit a website.

senses.meaningEn: an occasion when you go to see a person or place

examples.en: Thanks for the visit, come again soon.
examples.ko: 와 줘서 고마워, 또 놀러 와.

examples.en: This is my first visit to Busan.

senses.note: 명사일 때는 a visit to + 장소. pay a visit = 방문하다. 병원 진료도 a doctor's visit.

senses.meaningEn: the sound you make when you speak or sing

examples.en: She has a beautiful singing voice.
Please lower your voice, the baby is sleeping.
examples.ko: 목소리 좀 낮춰, 아기가 자고 있어.

senses.note: 목소리가 안 나오다 lose my voice. 큰 목소리로 in a loud voice. 전화 음성은 voice message.

senses.meaningEn: a man who serves food and drinks at a restaurant

examples.en: The waiter brought us the menu.
Let's ask the waiter for some water.

senses.note: 종업원을 부를 때 'Waiter!' 라고 소리치지 않음. 'Excuse me.' 가 자연스러움. 성별 중립 표현은 server.

senses.meaningEn: a woman who serves food and drinks at a restaurant

examples.en: The waitress was very kind to us.
She works as a waitress on weekends.

senses.note: 요즘은 성별 구분 없이 server 를 많이 씀. 사람을 직접 부를 때는 Excuse me.

senses.meaningEn: one of the flat sides of a room or building

examples.en: Let's paint the walls light blue.
There's a picture of us on the wall.

senses.note: 벽'에' 걸다는 on the wall(in 아님).

senses.meaningEn: a tall structure of stone or brick that goes around an area

examples.en: There's a stone wall around the old town.
The kids climbed over the wall into the yard.

senses.note: the Great Wall of China = 만리장성. 나무 울타리는 fence.

senses.meaningEn: to clean something with water and often soap

examples.en: Wash your hands before you eat.
I washed my face with cold water.

senses.note: wash my face(세수하다), wash my hair(머리 감다). 몸 전체를 씻는 것은 take a shower / take a bath.

senses.meaningEn: to clean clothes or dishes

examples.en: I'll wash the dishes after dinner.
Can you wash these jeans today?
examples.ko: 이 청바지 오늘 빨아 줄 수 있어?

senses.note: wash the dishes = do the dishes(설거지하다). wash the clothes = do the laundry(빨래하다).

senses.meaningEn: to look at something for a period of time

examples.en: We watched a movie together last night.
I like watching soccer on TV.
examples.ko: 나는 TV로 축구 보는 걸 좋아해.

senses.note: TV·영화·경기는 watch, 그냥 눈에 들어오는 건 see, 시선을 돌리는 건 look.

senses.meaningEn: a small clock you wear on your wrist

examples.en: I got a new watch for my birthday.
My watch says it's almost three.

senses.note: 벽시계는 clock, 손목시계는 watch.

senses.meaningEn: to be careful about something

examples.en: Watch your step, the floor is wet.
Watch out! A car is coming.

senses.note: Watch out! = 조심해! Watch your head = 머리 조심.

senses.meaningEn: the clear liquid that falls as rain and that people drink

examples.en: Can I have a glass of water, please?
Drink plenty of water every day.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사. a water 가 아니라 a glass of water, a bottle of water. 식당에서 생수는 bottled water, 수돗물은 tap water.

senses.meaningEn: to pour water on plants

examples.en: Don't forget to water the plants.
examples.ko: 식물에 물 주는 거 잊지 마.

examples.en: I water the garden every evening.

senses.note: give water to the plants 보다 water the plants 가 훨씬 자연스럽다.

senses.meaningEn: a very large, round fruit with a green skin and sweet red inside

examples.en: Nothing beats cold watermelon on a hot day.
Can you cut the watermelon into slices?

senses.note: 통째로는 a watermelon(셀 수 있음), 잘라 놓은 과육은 some watermelon(셀 수 없음). 한 조각은 a slice of watermelon. 참외·멜론류는 melon.

senses.meaningEn: not strong in body or health

examples.en: I feel weak after being sick all week.
Grandpa's legs are weak now, so he walks slowly.
examples.ko: 할아버지는 이제 다리가 약해서 천천히 걸으셔.

senses.note: week(주)와 발음이 같다(/wiːk/). 문맥으로 구분.

senses.meaningEn: having little flavor or not much of a substance in it

examples.en: This coffee is too weak for me.
I like my tea weak, with lots of milk.
examples.ko: 나는 차를 연하게, 우유 많이 넣어서 마셔.

senses.note: 커피·차가 연하면 weak, 진하면 strong. thin coffee 라고 하지 않는다.

senses.meaningEn: how heavy someone or something is

examples.en: I've gained some weight this winter.
What's the weight of this package?

senses.note: 살이 빠지다 lose weight, 살이 찌다 gain/put on weight. wait(기다리다)와 발음이 같다. 동사 '무게를 재다'는 weigh.

senses.meaningEn: a heavy object that you lift to make your muscles stronger

examples.en: He lifts weights at the gym three times a week.
examples.ko: 그는 일주일에 세 번 헬스장에서 웨이트를 해.

examples.en: Start with light weights and go slowly.

senses.note: lift weights = 근력 운동을 하다. 한국어 '헬스하다'에 가장 가까운 표현은 work out.

senses.meaningEn: the woman that a person is married to

examples.en: My wife and I moved here last year.
examples.ko: 아내와 나는 작년에 여기로 이사 왔어.

examples.en: This is my wife, Jiyoung.

senses.note: 복수는 wifes 가 아니라 wives /waɪvz/. 남의 아내는 your wife, 자기 아내는 my wife.

senses.meaningEn: a space in a wall with glass in it that lets in light and air

examples.en: Could you open the window? It's hot in here.
examples.ko: 창문 좀 열어 줄래? 여기 덥다.

examples.en: I like sitting by the window on the train.

senses.note: 창가 자리 = window seat(비행기·기차). 가게 진열창도 window(shop window).

senses.meaningEn: a box on a computer screen that shows a program or a web page

examples.en: Close that window and open a new one.
examples.ko: 그 창 닫고 새 창을 열어.

examples.en: The link opens in a new window.

senses.note: 브라우저 탭은 tab, 창은 window. 팝업 창은 pop-up window.

senses.meaningEn: to clean or dry something by rubbing it with a cloth or your hand

examples.en: Please wipe the table after dinner.
examples.ko: 저녁 먹고 식탁 좀 닦아 줘.

examples.en: Wipe your hands with this towel.

senses.note: wipe off(닦아 내다), wipe up(흘린 것을 닦다), wipe down(표면 전체를 닦다). clean 은 일반적인 청소, wipe 는 문질러 닦는 동작.

senses.meaningEn: an adult female person

examples.en: The woman in the blue dress is my teacher.
examples.ko: 파란 드레스 입은 여자분이 우리 선생님이야.

examples.en: Many women work at this company.

senses.note: 복수 women 의 발음은 /ˈwɪmɪn/ (위민). 단수 woman 은 /ˈwʊmən/ (우먼). 한국인이 자주 섞어 발음함.

senses.meaningEn: to do a job, especially for money

examples.en: I work at a bank downtown.
She works from home on Fridays.

senses.note: work at/for + 회사, work as + 직업.

senses.meaningEn: to function correctly

examples.en: The elevator isn't working again.
Does this remote work with the TV?

senses.note: 기계가 '된다/안 된다'는 work / doesn't work. 아주 자주 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: to have the result you want

examples.en: This medicine really works for headaches.
examples.ko: 이 약은 두통에 정말 효과가 있어.

examples.en: I tried your idea, and it worked!

senses.meaningEn: a job, or the place where you do it

examples.en: I have a lot of work to do today.
What time do you leave for work?

senses.note: work 는 셀 수 없는 명사. a work (X), many works (X). 직장 하나는 a job.

senses.meaningEn: the part of your body between your hand and your arm

examples.en: I hurt my wrist when I fell.
She wears a watch on her left wrist.

senses.note: w 는 발음하지 않음(/rɪst/). 발목은 ankle. 손목시계 = wristwatch.

senses.meaningEn: the area of land next to a house, usually with grass

examples.en: The kids are playing in the yard.
I need to cut the grass in the back yard.

senses.note: front yard(앞마당), backyard(뒷마당). 미국식 표현. 영국에서는 garden.

senses.meaningEn: a unit for measuring length, equal to about 0.9 meters

examples.en: The store is about a hundred yards from here.
He ran fifty yards in a few seconds.

senses.note: 1 yard = 3 feet ≈ 0.91m. 미식축구·거리 말할 때 자주 등장.

senses.meaningEn: a thick, slightly sour food made from milk

examples.en: I had yogurt with fruit this morning.
examples.ko: 오늘 아침에 과일 넣은 요거트를 먹었어.

examples.en: Can you buy some yogurt at the store?
examples.ko: 가게에서 요거트 좀 사 올 수 있어?

senses.note: yoghurt 로도 씀(영국식). 발음은 '요구르트'가 아니라 /ˈjoʊɡərt/. 한국의 마시는 요구르트는 drinkable yogurt.

senses.meaningEn: tasting very good (informal, often used by or with children)

examples.en: Yummy! I love this cake.
Mom made some yummy cookies for us.
examples.ko: 엄마가 우리한테 맛있는 쿠키를 만들어 주셨어.

senses.note: 아주 캐주얼한 말. 격식 있는 자리나 글에서는 delicious 를 씀. 반대말 yucky(맛없는, 더러운).
